fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and reporting on Miami Beach election results and the swearing-in of new councilmen; editorials criticizing racetrack and dog track gambling as a source of crime and juvenile delinquency; coverage of an anti-campaign against city commissioner H. Leslie Quigg; an investigation-style report on the Dade County delinquent tax certificate sale and alleged bidder collusion; discussion of Florida Power & Light financing and municipal ownership debates; local court and civic news including a nuisance case involving the Tropicana Bar near Northwest Hospital, a proposed effort to seek milk price reductions, and other community items and columns.
